using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Jellyfin.Database.Implementations;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests;

public class ReseedFolderFlagTests
{
    private const string DbFilename = "library.db.old";

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_RerunGuardFlagTrue_LogsSkipMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>>();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger.Object, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = true;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Migration is skipped because it does not apply."), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbDoesNotExist_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>>();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        paths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns("/data");
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger.Object, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogError("Cannot migrate IsFolder flag from {LibraryDb} as it does not exist. This migration expects the MigrateLibraryDb to run first.", "/data/" + DbFilename), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbExistsWithFolderItems_LogsItemCount()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>>();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        paths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "test-data"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(paths.Object.DataPath);
        
        var libraryDbPath = Path.Combine(paths.Object.DataPath, DbFilename);
        using var connection = new SqliteConnection($"Filename={libraryDbPath};Mode=Create");
        await connection.OpenAsync();
        await connection.ExecuteAsync("""
            CREATE TABLE TypedBaseItems (
                guid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                IsFolder INTEGER
            )
            """);
        await connection.ExecuteAsync("INSERT INTO TypedBaseItems (guid, IsFolder) VALUES ('guid1', 1)");
        await connection.ExecuteAsync("INSERT INTO TypedBaseItems (guid, IsFolder) VALUES ('guid2', 1)");
        await connection.DisposeAsync();

        var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
        var dbSetMock = new Mock<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbSet<Jellyfin.Data.Entities.BaseItem>>();
        dbContextMock.Setup(c => c.BaseItems).Returns(dbSetMock.Object);
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        provider.Setup(p => p.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(dbContextMock.Object);

        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger.Object, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Migrating the IsFolder flag for {Count} items.", 2), Times.Once);
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Migrating the IsFolder flag from library.db.old may take a while, do not stop Jellyfin."), Times.Once);

        // Cleanup
        File.Delete(libraryDbPath);
        Directory.Delete(paths.Object.DataPath);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbExistsWithNoFolderItems_LogsZeroCount()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>>();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        paths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "test-data-zero"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(paths.Object.DataPath);
        
        var libraryDbPath = Path.Combine(paths.Object.DataPath, DbFilename);
        using var connection = new SqliteConnection($"Filename={libraryDbPath};Mode=Create");
        await connection.OpenAsync();
        await connection.ExecuteAsync("""
            CREATE TABLE TypedBaseItems (
                guid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                IsFolder INTEGER
            )
            """);
        await connection.DisposeAsync();

        var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
        var dbSetMock = new Mock<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbSet<Jellyfin.Data.Entities.BaseItem>>();
        dbContextMock.Setup(c => c.BaseItems).Returns(dbSetMock.Object);
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        provider.Setup(p => p.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(dbContextMock.Object);

        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger.Object, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert - specifically tests line 67 with Count = 0
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Migrating the IsFolder flag for {Count} items.", 0), Times.Once);

        // Cleanup
        File.Delete(libraryDbPath);
        Directory.Delete(paths.Object.DataPath);
    }
}

using System;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests;

public class ReseedFolderFlagTests
{
    private const string DbFilename = "library.db.old";

    private class MockStartupLogger : IStartupLogger<ReseedFolderFlag>
    {
        public List<(LogLevel level, string message, object[] args)> Logs { get; } = new();

        public void LogInformation(string message, params object[] args) =>
            Logs.Add((LogLevel.Information, message, args));

        public void LogError(string message, params object[] args) =>
            Logs.Add((LogLevel.Error, message, args));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_RerunGuardFlagTrue_LogsSkipMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new MockStartupLogger();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = true;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        var log = Assert.Single(logger.Logs);
        Assert.Equal(LogLevel.Information, log.level);
        Assert.Equal("Migration is skipped because it does not apply.", log.message);
        Assert.Empty(log.args);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbDoesNotExist_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new MockStartupLogger();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        paths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns("/data");
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        var log = Assert.Single(logger.Logs.Where(l => l.level == LogLevel.Error));
        Assert.Equal("Cannot migrate IsFolder flag from {LibraryDb} as it does not exist. This migration expects the MigrateLibraryDb to run first.", log.message);
        Assert.Equal("/data/library.db.old", log.args[0]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbExistsWithFolderItems_LogsItemCount()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        var dataPath = Path.Combine(tempDir, "data");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dataPath);
        var libraryDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, DbFilename);

        // Create test DB with 2 folder items
        using (var connection = new SqliteConnection($"Filename={libraryDbPath};Mode=Create"))
        {
            await connection.OpenAsync();
            await connection.ExecuteAsync("""
                CREATE TABLE TypedBaseItems (
                    guid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    IsFolder INTEGER
                )
                """);
            await connection.ExecuteAsync("INSERT INTO TypedBaseItems (guid, IsFolder) VALUES ('guid1', 1)");
            await connection.ExecuteAsync("INSERT INTO TypedBaseItems (guid, IsFolder) VALUES ('guid2', 1)");
        }

        var logger = new MockStartupLogger();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        paths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);

        var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
        var baseItemsDbSetMock = new Mock<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbSet<Jellyfin.Data.Entities.BaseItem>>();
        dbContextMock.Setup(c => c.BaseItems).Returns(baseItemsDbSetMock.Object);
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        provider.Setup(p => p.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(dbContextMock.Object);

        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert - specifically tests line 67
        var countLog = logger.Logs.First(l => l.message.Contains("{Count}"));
        Assert.Equal("Migrating the IsFolder flag for {Count} items.", countLog.message);
        Assert.Equal(2, countLog.args[0]);

        // Cleanup
        Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task PerformAsync_LibraryDbExistsWithNoFolderItems_LogsZeroCount()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        var dataPath = Path.Combine(tempDir, "data");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dataPath);
        var libraryDbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, DbFilename);

        // Create test DB with no folder items
        using (var connection = new SqliteConnection($"Filename={libraryDbPath};Mode=Create"))
        {
            await connection.OpenAsync();
            await connection.ExecuteAsync("""
                CREATE TABLE TypedBaseItems (
                    guid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    IsFolder INTEGER
                )
                """);
            // No folder items inserted
        }

        var logger = new MockStartupLogger();
        var paths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
        paths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);

        var dbContextMock = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
        var baseItemsDbSetMock = new Mock<Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbSet<Jellyfin.Data.Entities.BaseItem>>();
        dbContextMock.Setup(c => c.BaseItems).Returns(baseItemsDbSetMock.Object);
        var provider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
        provider.Setup(p => p.CreateDbContextAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(dbContextMock.Object);

        var migration = new ReseedFolderFlag(logger, provider.Object, paths.Object);
        ReseedFolderFlag.RerunGuardFlag = false;

        // Act
        await migration.PerformAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert - specifically tests line 67 with Count = 0
        var countLog = logger.Logs.First(l => l.message.Contains("{Count}"));
        Assert.Equal("Migrating the IsFolder flag for {Count} items.", countLog.message);
        Assert.Equal(0, countLog.args[0]);
